jobs.occupation: Cyber Services Program and Product Lead (Leiter/in - Projekt-/Programmmanagement)
jobs.description:
As a Cyber Services Product and Program Lead (m/f/d), you will be responsible for shaping Vestas Cyber Security Services.

You will work in Vestas Service business area and manage the commercial portfolio of OT and Cyber Security Services, this is a dual role that combines product and program ownership.

This position sits within Global Service Commercial, under Plant and Energy Solutions Product Development. The responsibility of the department is to define and mature-to-market plant, cyber and digital service offerings for selling long term service agreements and other contractual service offerings within the renewable energy sector. Cyber security is an important strategic initiative that supports Vestas' vision to be a leader in renewable energy solutions and shall ensure long-term profitability and competitiveness of Vestas Service business.

Join us in ensuring resilient cybersecurity solutions in the global renewable energy projects.

Ready to safeguard the energy revolution?

Responsibilities:

As Cyber Services Product and Program Lead you will work closely with global and regional cross-functional teams to lead the roadmap of cyber security services within Vestas' service business. The role will be the Global Service Commercial product lead for bringing ideas to market around Vestas' cyber security offerings.

- Program Management - you oversee the portfolio of our projects in the OT and Cyber Security services area. You are first point of contact on reporting around our initiatives, summarizing development budgets and defining governance in cooperation with other departments. You support strategic work and can manage projects, when needed.
- Service product roadmap - you will be responsible to build a long-term roadmap while ensuring the strategic direction is firm and accepted in close alignment with relevant parts of the business. You will position the services with reference to different market and customer groups, lead competitor and industry analysis, ensure business case development and alignment with relevant functions and integrate commercial and technical elements into cohesive offerings.
- Product Management - you take Cyber Security service product and solutions to market that are scalable, standardized and matured to ensure high market efficiency, risk management optimization and highest possible value contribution. You lead the launch of our solutions and understand what our frontline requires for selling. You can produce relevant commercial documentation, define commercial structures and manage internal product training.
- Requirement management - you understand customer expectations and are skilled in working with Global Experts in gathering requirements, that you will translate towards new services design. On top, you can formulate commercial targets making sure our services can be effectively deployed with customers.You can facilitate alignment across functions when trade-offs are required to deliver effective and scalable solutions.
- Product Accountability - you provide support to the regional sales teams in responding to customer and sales request as a go-to-market lead post-launch.

Qualifications:

- Academic background in Business Engineering, Computer Science, Information Technology (IT), Operational Technology (OT), Engineering, or a related field.
- Proven experience as a Project Manager within a technology-driven environment.
- Experience working effectively in a matrix organization.
- Ideally, a background in a commercially focused role
- Solid understanding of networking technologies, SCADA systems, and cybersecurity, gained through professional experience is a plus.
- Previous experience in the renewable energy industry is considered a strong advantage.
- Excellent command of English; German language skills are a plus.

Competencies:

- Genuine passion for the renewable energy industry and Cyber Security
- Experience with matrixed organizations and building strong stakeholder relationships
- Ability to navigate leadership and colleagues equally as well as sales and engineering teams
- Proven track record in developing and executing strategies that deliver results
- Ability to handle multiple assignments, passionate and highly persistent
- Solid technological aptitude with the ability to translate complex technical concepts to general audiences, in speaking and writing
- Snr. Leadership communication experience

Your benefits – because your contribution counts!

- Start & Perspective: Structured onboarding program and a permanent employment contract with long-term prospects 
- Development & Skills: Varied work in a forward-looking industry and individual opportunities for professional growth
- Flexibility & Work-Life Balance: Overtime account, option to work from home up to 8 days per month, 30 days of vacation plus Christmas Eve and New Year’s Eve off, and the option for a sabbatical 
- Add-Ons: Business bike, gym allowance, company pension plan, Germany-wide train ticket (Deutschlandticket) 
- Team & Culture: Scandinavian-inspired with flat hierarchies, informal culture, and great team spirit
- You will join a small and evolving organization, where you are empowered to lead, define, motivate and shape how Vestas and its customers are made fit for future.

jobs.occupation: Structural Analysis Engineer VTP (d/f/m) (Ingenieur/in - Luft- und Raumfahrttechnik)
jobs.description:
About us

Airbus pioneers sustainable aerospace for a safe and united world. The Company constantly innovates to provide efficient and technologically-advanced solutions in aerospace, defence, and connected services. In commercial aircraft, Airbus offers modern and fuel-efficient airliners and associated services. Airbus is also a European leader in defence and security and one of the world's leading space businesses. In helicopters, Airbus provides the most efficient civil and military rotorcraft solutions and services worldwide.
Job description

In order to support our engineering activities, Airbus Aerostructures is looking for a

Structural Analysis Engineer VTP (d/f/m)

You will be part of a young team of development engineers taking care of the technical steering of projects in the Vertical Tail Plane (VTP) primary and secondary structure perimeter, for the new and incremental development of the complete Single Aisle, WideBody Family and A400M. Working on feasibility studies, supporting the detailed design and in the certification phase, managing structure-driven projects will be part of your job.

Your Location

You will be working at the largest production site for civil aircraft situated in Hamburg. Its location on the southern banks of the river Elbe includes the option to commute by ferry. Experience the special flair of Hamburg in your spare time where vibrant cosmopolitan culture meets nautic legacy.

Our Benefits for You

- Fair Compensation & Extras: Attractive remuneration and individual additional benefits, such as company pension schemes, mobility offers (e.g., bike leasing), or corporate discounts with partner companies in accordance with our current guidelines.
- Time for You (and Your Loved Ones): 30 days of annual leave based on our collective agreement (35-hour week); work-life balance through flexible working hours (flextime), mobile working, part-time options, job sharing, and sabbatical opportunities.
- Growth Made Easy: Excellent professional development opportunities and international, group-wide career perspectives.
- Feel Good at Work: On-site company doctor; comprehensive health programs (sports courses, preventive care, etc.), canteen and cafeteria, and local childcare facilities at selected locations.
- Diversity Connects: Work in a diverse environment with more than 140 nationalities, where exchange, mutual support, and inclusion are part of our DNA.

Your Tasks and Responsibilities

- Rely on your experience in the domain Fatigue and Damage Tolerance and/or Structure Analysis in order to take over the technical management of related projects
- Analyze and validate composite & hybrid structures for static & fatigue strength according to validated methods and perform related feasibility studies
- Prepare, Check and Approve stress deliverables in line with Airbus’s processes, methods and policies
- Check adherence to airworthiness regulations, relevant design principles, processes, methods and manufacturing capabilities guidelines
- Compile all required documents related to support A/C and MODs certification
- Act as interface for the relevant stakeholders
- Ensure that relevant inputs are provided and fulfill to airworthiness regulations, the Design for the creation of drawings for manufacture and provide support to other functions (i.e. R&T, customer support) as needed
- Perform monitoring and support of Sub-contracting firms providing structure analysis work
- Work on Digitalization, automate and simplify, redesign processes and procedures

****

Desired Skills and Qualifications

- You have a Master Degree (or equivalent) in Engineering, Aerospace, Civil Engineering or comparable
- You have experience in (preferred) Fatigue and Damage Tolerance and/or Structural Analysis methods. This includes experience in finite element method
- You are experienced in tools like ISAMI, FEM e.g. Altair Hyperworks, Nastran, PASS SSCI and TREND
- You hold a technical approval delegation according to Airbus M1020 (for static and/or fatigue) or sufficient experience to obtain this delegation quickly
- You are interested or have an affinity to Data analytics
- You have an open and curious mindset for new ways of working as well as a practical, agile and independent approach
- Your are team-oriented and eager to join a young team in a young organization and shape ways of working
- You are fluent in English and German

jobs.occupation: Lead SAP EWM Consultant (f/m/d) (ERP-Berater/in - ERP-Consultant)
jobs.description:
In our SAP Engineering team, we continuously develop the technical processes in which we use SAP across the Fielmann Group. Our focus is mainly on Supply Chain as well as Finance & Controlling. Together with the business stakeholders, we make sure that our SAP solutions support efficient, reliable and scalable processes.

In this role, you will take ownership of our SAP EWM domain with a strong focus on warehouse automation. You will not only bring deep technical SAP EWM expertise, but also act as an internal partner for the business: understanding warehouse processes, challenging requirements, driving decisions and steering external partners from an inhouse owner perspective.

What you can expect. Your responsibilities.

- Take ownership of the SAP EWM domain and drive its further development together with logistics, IT and external partners.
- Lead SAP EWM projects with a strong focus on warehouse automation, such as shuttle systems, material flow systems and automated warehouse technologies.
- Act as an internal business consultant for warehouse and logistics stakeholders: understand business needs, challenge requirements and translate them into scalable SAP EWM solutions.
- Drive decisions across business, IT and implementation partners and make sure requirements, priorities and dependencies are clear
- Design and drive the implementation and continuous improvement of SAP EWM solutions for efficient, reliable and scalable warehouse operations.
- Manage end-to-end integration of SAP EWM with SAP S/4HANA, SAP QM, physical inventory software and other logistics modules.
- Steer external partners and service providers from an internal owner perspective, including SLA and KPI definition, monitoring and continuous improvement.
- Ensure successful testing, validation, go-live and operational stability of SAP EWM solutions.

Why we’re excited about you. Your profile.

- You have a degree in Information Technology, Business Informatics, Logistics or a related field.
- You have several years of experience with SAP EWM and have already taken ownership of an SAP EWM, warehouse or logistics domain in an inhouse or comparable long-term ownership role.
- You know how to advise business stakeholders, shape requirements and drive decisions instead of only implementing predefined solutions.
- You have a solid understanding of the integration between SAP EWM, SAP S/4HANA and SAP QM.
- You have proven experience in warehouse automation projects; experience with material flow systems and automated warehouse control is a strong plus.
- You bring strong project management skills and experience in end-to-end logistics processes.
- You communicate confidently with business, IT and external partners, manage different stakeholder interests and keep decisions moving.
- You think analytically, solve problems in a structured way, communicate confidently in English and are willing to travel regularly between the Fielmann Group Head Office in Hamburg and our logistics sites; German skills are a plus.

We give it our all. Your benefits.

- Attractive salary, 13th salary with the option to convert it into additional time off.
- Annual budget of €1,080 for Fielmann products for you and your family.
- Employee shares, capital-forming benefits and many additional perks.
- Flexible working hours and up to 60% remote work per month upon agreement with your team.
- Professional and personal development at the Fielmann Academy at Schloss Plön.
- A secure and future-oriented work environment that combines innovation, growth and a strong team culture.

Are you looking for an environment where you can contribute your expertise and grow long-term? Applying via our career portal only takes a few minutes. Ideally, please also indicate your preferred start date and salary expectations. We’re looking forward to getting to know you! Your contact in recruiting is Marleen Michielse.

Fielmann is one of the largest family-owned companies in Europe and the third-largest company in the optical industry. We stand for quality, reliability and modern craftsmanship. With our omnichannel model across eyewear, contact lenses and hearing systems, we actively shape the future of the industry. Show us your strengths. Join us. Apply now.

At Nect, we make digitalization tangible and secure. We develop AI- and biometrics-based trust services, including digital identity and signature solutions. Sounds technical? It is - but, more importantly, it’s exciting. Our technologies help public authorities and businesses prepare for the digital future. We are driven by our desire to demonstrate the simplicity and security of digital solutions while creating new opportunities for all. Are you ready to help shape the digital world of tomorrow with us?

About the role:

We are looking for a highly skilled Senior Machine Learning Expert to design, build, deploy, and optimize large-scale machine learning systems powering next-generation identity verification products. In this role, you will collaborate closely with ML scientists, backend engineers, DevOps teams, and product stakeholders to productionize advanced AI models used by millions of users every day. At Nect, you will have the opportunity to work on state-of-the-art machine learning technologies in biometrics, computer vision, and fraud prevention while helping shape scalable AI infrastructure for real-world applications.

You are responsible for:

Machine Learning Engineering

- Design, develop, deploy, and optimize machine learning systems for identity verification products at scale.
- Productionize advanced AI and deep learning models in collaboration with ML scientists and engineering teams.
- Improve model performance, reliability, scalability, and inference efficiency.
- Build and maintain robust ML pipelines for training, deployment, monitoring, and retraining.
- Optimize real-time inference systems for high-throughput production environments.

Backend & Infrastructure

- Develop scalable Python-based backend services and microservices architectures.
- Deploy ML models through REST APIs and real-time inference services.
- Work with distributed systems and cloud-native infrastructure.
- Contribute to CI/CD workflows and operational excellence for ML services.

Collaboration & Technical Contribution

- Work cross-functionally with Product, Engineering, Infrastructure, and Security teams.
- Participate in architecture discussions and technical decision-making.
- Help drive best practices in MLOps, scalability, and system reliability.

You bring with you:

- MSc or PhD in Computer Science, Machine Learning, Software Engineering, or a related field
- 5+ years of Machine Learning Engineering experience
- Experience with fraud prevention and detection (on media such as videos and images) and anti-spoofing.
- Experience working with biometric and media data (images, videos, audio), including face recognition, selfie verification, voice analysis, and ideally deepfake detection
- Combination of industry experience and a strong research background
- Strong Python skills
- Proven experience building, deploying, and operating ML systems in production environments
- Strong expertise in Computer Vision, Deep Learning, ML Pipelines, and MLOps
- Fluent English skills required

What we offer you:

- Flexible working and a modern working environment
- Scale-up culture with security and vision: digital, innovative, ambitious
- Flat hierarchies and quick decisions: real scope for your ideas
- Personal development: in a growing tech company with a future
- Modern office in Hamburg: central location between the Elbe and Alster rivers with a pleasant working atmosphere
- Health benefits: company health insurance package
- Team spirit: regular events and exchanges in a motivated environment
- Catering support: subsidy for your daily meals/snacks

Ready to help shape digital identity in Europe?

Then apply now - we look forward to hearing from you!

jobs.occupation: Regional Head (m,w,d) of Tax, Central and Eastern Europe (Steuerberater/in)
jobs.description:
Who we are

Worldline helps businesses of all shapes and sizes to accelerate their growth journey - quickly, simply, and securely. We are the innovators at the heart of the payments technology industry, shaping how the world pays and gets paid. Our technology powers the growth of millions of businesses across 5 continents. And just as we help our customers accelerate their business, we are committed to helping our people accelerate their careers. Together, we shape the evolution.

The opportunity

At Worldline, our technology addresses persistent challenges of the payment world. We design and operate leading digital payment and transactional solutions that enable sustainable economic growth and reinforce trust and security in our societies. If you are a highly-skilled Tax director, specialized in German and Swiss tax, then get ready to join our company.

This role will report to the Group Head of Tax.

Day-to-day responsibilities

As a Regional Head (m,w,d) of Tax, Central and Eastern Europe, which include main entities notably in Germany, Switzerland, Austria and Poland, you will be in charge of all the tax aspects related to this perimeter that can evolve depending on the activity. You will be the key contact and stakeholder of local accounting, controlling, legal and finances teams, as well as the main interlocutor for local tax authorities. You will also work closely with the group tax team in order to ensure proper implementation of group tax policy and strategy.

Your key responsibilities include:

- Manage tax aspects of subsidiaries mainly in Germany, Austria, Switzerland and Poland (including country-specific tax structuring, transfer pricing compliance, limitation of interest deductibility, and local tax consolidation group) and compliance aspects, as CIT, VAT, local taxes returns and ensure compliance with local regulations.
- Support local finance teams for annual financial statements under IFRS and local accounting rules (German HGB, Austrian UGB, Swiss GAAP); ensure correct and optimal application of IFRS, translating IFRS and tax standards into practical processes used across administrations.
- Take ownership of tax processes at Group level for the Tax Cluster area and ensure coordination between local teams, Group Finance, and external advisors (including transfer pricing documentation, foreign tax credits, local incentives, and subsidies)
- Provide advice and support to group tax team, finance, legal and operational teams on  tax matters including CIT, VAT, and country-specific taxes and compliance requirements. Identify issues and drive effective solutions
- Conduct tax monitoring across the Tax Cluster perimeter, build local tax manuals and guides that are user friendly and understandable to a larger audience; train local finance and tax teams when required
- Ensure management of tax audits and litigations as well as relationships with tax authorities in each jurisdiction: prepare, coordinate and validate responses (with support from external advisors if necessary).
- Anticipate and assess tax risks across the Tax cluster perimeter, considering local regulatory changes and multi-country implications and work closely with group tax team in this respect. Identify issues and drive effective solutions
- Support the group and local finance teams on reporting (budget/actuals/forecast), on the determination of tax results, current and deferred tax charges and VAT recovery ratio across all  Tax Cluster entities, coordinate the tax reporting and tax package process with local stakeholders, automate and improve processes, and harmonize local submissions as appropriate.
- Monitor tax legislation and case law developments and ensure proactive adaptation.

This list is non-exhaustive and is intended to evolve with the position and the person who joins the team.

Who are we looking for

We look for big thinkers. People who can drive positive change, step up and show what’s next – people with passion, can-do attitude and a hunger to learn and grow.

- Minimum 12 years of experience within international direct taxation at Big4, international law firm or at a multinational organization; pursued graduation from university (Tax Law or Tax Economics).
- Professional proficiency of English and German is required
- Expert in Excel and good knowledge of reporting tool (SAP)
- You demonstrate expertise in international Group tax matters, leveraging your previous experience.
- You are diligent, independent, proactive, with strong analytical and synthesis abilities, and excellent written communication skills. 
- You take initiative, bring forward strategic proposals, and have strong interpersonal capabilities.
- Knowledge of the payments, eCommerce or FinTech industry is a plus.

Perks & Benefits

At Worldline you’ll get the chance to be at the heart of the global payments technology industry and shape how the world pays and gets paid. On top of that, you will also:

- Be part of a company guided by a strong purpose to do good and recognized as top 1% of the most sustainable companies in all sectors worldwide
- Work with inspiring colleagues and be empowered to learn, grow and accelerate your career
- An exciting salary
- At Worldline our top priority is to engage, encourage and develop you to help you improve your potential. In fact, we have comprehensive training and development programs in place demonstrating our dedication to developing your career
- And many more...

#LI-AB1

Shape the evolution

We are on an exciting journey towards the next frontiers of payments technology, and we look for big thinkers, people with passion, can-do attitude and a hunger to learn and grow. Here you'll work with ambitious colleagues from around the world, take on unique challenges as a team, and make a real impact on the society. With an empowering culture, strong technology and extensive training opportunities, we help you accelerate your career - wherever you decide to go. Join our global team of 18,000 innovators and shape a tomorrow that is yours to own. 

Learn more about life at Worldline at jobs.worldline.com

We are proud to be an Equal Opportunity employer. We do not discriminate based upon race, religion, color, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, status as an individual with a disability, or any applicable legally protected characteristics.

jobs.description:

Product Owner in the ERP (ARP) /SAP Transformation (d/f/m)

We believe this initiative will set new industry standards and significantly enhance our operational efficiency and enable the ramp-up. We're not just implementing SAP; we're reimagining how aerospace manufacturing operates and we drive our E2E flows.

You will be working at the largest production site for civil aircraft situated in Hamburg. Its location on the southern banks of the river Elbe includes the option to commute by ferry. - Translate complex data into clear documentation and visualizations, driving stakeholder buy-in and team alignment.
- Ensure our processes align with SAP standards and global strategies, driving efficiency and consistency.
- Collaborate with Agile/SAFe Multi-Functional Teams to deliver seamless solutions.
- Potential to lead pioneering projects integrating emerging technologies with SAP solutions.

Desired skills and qualifications

- Change Management and Project Management expertise.

jobs.occupation: EMEA Logistics Senior Purchaser (m/w/d) (Einkäufer/in)
jobs.description:
The Regional Procurement Office (RPO) EMEA is responsible for procurement activities across Europe, Africa, the Middle East, and the Balkans. Within RPO EMEA, the Logistics Procurement Hub manages the sourcing of inland transportation services for wind turbine components, including port handling, factory-to-port transport, and delivery to installation sites. Our diverse and collaborative team supports wind energy projects across the region.

Responsibilities

The Logistics Senior Purchaser (m/f/d) is responsible for leading the sourcing and procurement of transport services for wind turbine components across the EMEA region, ensuring competitive, compliant, and strategically aligned solutions that support both tendering activities and project execution.

The role includes developing sourcing strategies, leading complex RFQs, conducting market analysis, negotiating commercial agreements, and managing supplier performance. The Specialist will work closely with stakeholders across logistics, construction, sales, finance, and legal functions to deliver value, mitigate risks, support business objectives, and contribute to winning projects and successful project execution.

This position is ideal for an experienced procurement professional with a strong commercial mindset, proven negotiation skills, and the ability to independently manage procurement activities in a dynamic international environment.

Key Responsibilities:

- Strategic Sourcing & RFQ Management: Develop and execute sourcing strategies, prepare and manage RFQs, and lead supplier selection processes to ensure competitive and reliable transportation solutions.
- Cost Management & Market Intelligence: Own the development and maintenance of transportation cost models and market benchmarks. Analyze supplier quotations, validate cost structures, and challenge pricing assumptions to ensure competitiveness and transparency. Identify market trends, risks, and opportunities, forecast cost developments, and provide data-driven recommendations that support sourcing strategies, tender activities, and business decisions.
- Bid & Project Support: Play a key role in supporting sales, tendering activities, and project execution by securing competitive transportation solutions, supplier capacity, and commercial insights. Develop accurate cost assessments and recommendations that contribute to winning projects while ensuring successful execution after award.
- Commercial Negotiation & Contract Management: Lead commercial negotiations and support the development of contractual agreements that align with business requirements while mitigating commercial and operational risks.
- Supplier Management & Development: Build and maintain strategic supplier relationships, monitor supplier performance, and drive continuous improvement initiatives related to cost, quality, capacity, and service delivery.
- Compliance & Stakeholder Collaboration: Ensure procurement activities comply with company policies and governance requirements while collaborating closely with logistics, construction, finance, legal, and sales stakeholders.

Qualifications

- 5+  years of experience in Procurement, Strategic Sourcing, Supply Chain, or a similar commercial function
- Bachelor’s degree in Supply Chain Management, Business Administration, International Trade, Economics, Logistics, Industrial Engineering, or a related field
- German language skills at native speaker level are mandatory; Business-level English proficiency is essential, as all day-to-day communication, reporting, and documentation are conducted in English
- Experience within transport, logistics, heavy haulage, project cargo, infrastructure, energy, or other project-based industries is highly desirable, particularly in the planning and execution of oversized cargo transportation to site. Knowledge of route surveys, road modifications, permit management, and other requirements associated with wind turbine transportation is a strong advantage
- Advanced Excel skills and proficiency with analytical tools, with proven experience in price analysis, cost benchmarking, data interpretation, and identifying opportunities for cost optimization and process improvement
- Experience leading supplier negotiations and managing commercial agreements in a multinational environment
- Strong understanding of sourcing processes, supplier relationship management, contract negotiation, and procurement best practices
- Knowledge of SAP Ariba (Sourcing module) or similar procurement platforms is considered an advantage
- Willingness to travel occasionally across the EMEA region, as required (typically less than 15% of the time)

Competencies

- Strong analytical and commercial mindset with exceptional attention to detail. Comfortable working with data, conducting detailed price and cost comparisons, identifying trends and improvement opportunities, and translating insights into actionable recommendations
- Results-oriented, accountable, and proactive, with a strong sense of ownership and commitment to delivering objectives
- Strong negotiation, stakeholder management, and influencing skills, with the ability to build trusted relationships across functions, suppliers, and cultures
- Ability to work independently, manage multiple priorities, and make sound decisions in a dynamic international environment
- Collaborative, adaptable, and easy to work with, fostering open communication and constructive partnerships with colleagues and suppliers

What We Offer 

We offer an exciting opportunity to join one of the world's leading renewable energy companies and play a key role in the procurement of transportation services supporting wind energy projects across the EMEA region. You will work in a highly international environment with significant exposure to strategic sourcing, supplier management, contract negotiations, and cross-functional collaboration. The role offers opportunities for professional growth, responsibility, and direct impact on business performance and project success. 

Your benefits – because your contribution counts!

- Start & Perspective: Structured onboarding program and a permanent employment contract with long-term prospects 
- Development & Skills: Varied work in a forward-looking industry and individual opportunities for professional growth
- Flexibility & Work-Life Balance: Overtime account, option to work from home up to 8 days per month, 30 days of vacation plus Christmas Eve and New Year’s Eve off, and the option for a sabbatical 
- Add-Ons: Business bike, gym allowance, company pension plan, Germany-wide train ticket (Deutschlandticket) 
- Team & Culture: Scandinavian-inspired with flat hierarchies, informal culture, and great team spirit

jobs.occupation: Postdoc (m/w/d) (Molekularbiologe/-biologin)
jobs.description:
Institute of Physiology and Cell Biology. Starting date: as soon as possible, at the latest September 1,2026.

Area of responsibility

The Institute of Physiology and Cell Biology aims to recruit a highly motivated post-doctoral scientistto join the Cell Biology group, headed by Prof. Dr. Sjoerd van Wijk. We study how ubiquitination andautophagy control cell survival, programmed cell death, inflammation and cell differentiation inbroad pathophysiological settings, including oncology and infection. For this, human and animalpre-clinical experimental systems, including cell lines, primary cells, organoids and iPSC-derivedcells, will be integrated with cell biology with biochemistry, molecular biology and omicsapproaches, including CRISPR/Cas9 gene editing, super-resolution and confocal microscopy andmass-spectrometry. For examples of recent research, see Wächtershäuser et al, Signal TransductTarget Ther, 11(1):204; Zein et al, Autophagy, 21(5):1075-1095 and Weinelt et al, Cell Death Dis,15(1):77.

The position will be closely involved in shaping the research group, setting up the lab and planningand performing independent research at the interface of cell biology, biochemistry and molecularbiology with imaging and computational data analysis. The successful candidate will play centralroles in collaborations between different scientific and clinical research groups and in developinginnovative approaches in comparative cell biology to improve animal and human health. Theposition furthermore combines opportunities for teaching, scientific and academic qualification(Habilitation) and the development of independent research projects within the scope of the group.

Key Focus Areas:

• Independent experimental scientific research in comparative cell biology.

• Teaching and supervision of Bachelor, Master and PhD students/Habilitation.

• Coordination of lab setup and daily running.

• Contribution to the development and implementation of integrative analytical approaches forcell biology, biochemistry and molecular biology, incl. multi-omics, CRISPR/Cas-basedapproaches, imaging and bioinformatic image analysis.

• Support in the analysis of large datasets (e.g., RNA-seq, single-cell data and imaging).

• Support in the preparation of scientific publications and grant applications, for example for theGerman Research Foundation.

• Organization of scientific exchange activities, workshops and project meetings.

Recruitment requirements:

• A university degree and doctoral degree/PhD in (Molecular) Cell Biology, Biochemistry, MolecularBiology, Biology, Veterinary Medicine ("Approbation"), or a related discipline.

• Excellent written and spoken German and English language skills.

• Experience with, or strong interest in, multiscale imaging, CRISPR/Cas-based methods andprimary cell/tissue culture (organoids).

• Basic knowledge in the analysis of high-dimensional biological datasets, particularly microscopicdatasets.

• Knowledge of additional disciplines, including systems biology, gene regulation, epigenomics ormultiscale data integration, is advantageous.

Required professional knowledge and personal skills:

• Ability to communicate complex scientific concepts across disciplinary boundaries.

• Independent, structured and solution-oriented working style.

• Excellent organizational, communication and teamwork skills.

• Willingness to contribute to scientific coordination, develop independent research questions andparticipate in the preparation of publications and grant applications.

• Curious, strong analytical and conceptual thinking skills combined with the ability to developinnovative solutions.

• Flexibility and willingness to rapidly familiarize oneself with new technologies and researchareas.

What we offer:

• Special annual bonus

• Flexible working hours

• 30 days holiday

• Additional retirement arrangement: Pension Institution of the Federal Republic and the FederalStates (the company pension of the public service)

• Staff canteen with discount meal offers

• Participation in university sports at a discount

• Targeted further education and training opportunities

• Family friendliness

• Appreciative working atmosphere with contemporary management culture

The employment relationship is subject to the public sector collective agreement on the federalstates (TV-L). Severely disabled applicants will be given priority in the case of equal suitability. TheUniversity of Veterinary Medicine Hannover particularly wants to promote the professional equalityof men and women. Therefore, it strives to increase the underrepresented gender in the respective area.

Contact:

For more information, please contact Prof. Dr. Sjoerd van Wijk, Institute ofPhysiology and Cell Biology via telephone number +49 511 953-6119 or

Sjoerd.van.Wijk@tiho-hannover.de

When preparing your application, please include your CV, a motivation letter with ashort statement of your research plans and how your expertise would contribute tothe aims of our group, an overview of publications and third-party funding, as wellas the contact information of three referees. Applications should be submitted viaour online portal by 31.07.2026 at the latest.

All application documents will be destroyed after completion of the personnelselection process. Your personal data will be treated confidentially. Please see www.tiho-hannover.de/ds-bew for more information.

jobs.description:
About us

Airbus pioneers sustainable aerospace for a safe and united world. The Company constantly innovates to provide efficient and technologically-advanced solutions in aerospace, defence, and connected services. In commercial aircraft, Airbus offers modern and fuel-efficient airliners and associated services. Airbus is also a European leader in defence and security and one of the world's leading space businesses. In helicopters, Airbus provides the most efficient civil and military rotorcraft solutions and services worldwide.
Job description

In order to support Airframe Engineering, Airbus Operations is looking for a

F&DT Lead Engineer for Fuselage Primary Structure (d/f/m)

Become part of a pioneering team with a strong identity and a shared commitment to delivering best-in-class stress solutions!

Join the Fuselage Structure Analysis team in Hamburg as a technical anchor in our newly integrated "One Fuselage" domain. As the Lead Engineer Fatigue & Damage Tolerance (F&DT) for Primary Structure, you will be a custodian of structural integrity, driving the F&DT justification for critical fuselage components across the entire aircraft lifecycle—from next-generation design and certification to manufacturing and global fleet support.

You will lead the delivery of mission-critical stress engineering data and shape the departmental strategy for innovation. This is a pivotal role where you will collaborate across a high-level network to integrate advanced simulations and structural health strategies. We are looking for a pioneering engineer driven by a "People First" spirit to help us create the future of aerospace structural excellence.

This role is also available with reduced weekly hours and an adapted scope of tasks.

Your location - 2 options

Hamburg is home to the largest production site for civil aircraft. Experience the special flair of Hamburg in your spare time where vibrant cosmopolitan culture meets nautic legacy.

Bremen is one of the country’s greenest cities. It offers wonderful sights, a rich culture, urban flair and culinary delights.

Your benefits

- Attractive salary and special payments
- 30 days paid vacation and extra days-off for special occasions
- Excellent upskilling opportunities and great international, group wide development prospects
- Special benefits: employer-funded pension, employee stock options, discounted car leasing, special conditions for insurances, transportation subsidy, employee benefits at cooperating companies
- On-site-facilities: Kindergarten close to the site, medical officer for check-ups and other health-related services, canteen and cafeteria
- Compatibility of family & work (job sharing, part-time models, flexible working hours, individual timeout)
- Working in a diverse environment, with more than 140 nationalities, where every voice is heard

Your tasks and responsibilities

- Lead Advanced Structural Analysis: Technically lead the project team for the fatigue and damage tolerance evaluations
- Define Airworthiness & Maintenance Criteria: Establish damage tolerance philosophies, including allowable damage limits, inspection thresholds, and repeat intervals to ensure long-term structural integrity
- Oversee Structural Testing: Plan and analyze fatigue tests across all levels, validating theoretical models with real-world data
- Drive Cross-Functional Certification: Collaborate with Design, Materials, and Stress teams to integrate F&DT requirements into the design phase, ensuring full compliance with regulatory airworthiness standards
- Support Fleet In-Service Solutions: Investigate structural failures and anomalies to determine root causes, while developing and validating effective repair schemes and service bulletins
- Manage Technical Project Deliverables: Define technical scopes, workload sizing, and lead times, ensuring high-quality inputs and the mitigation of technical risks/opportunities
- Strategic Reporting & Governance: Present progress and technical findings in steering ceremonies, providing clear clarification of assumptions and interdependencies to stakeholders
- Continuous Innovation & Method Improvement: Stay at the forefront of industry advancements to improve internal analysis tools, structural health monitoring strategies, and airworthiness limitation frameworks

In essence, you plan, structure, and deliver technical outputs for your area in Time, Cost and Quality. You guide colleagues and provide technical expertise, supported by senior team members.

- You bring several years of experience in Fatigue & Damage Tolerance and associated Process, Methods & Tools

jobs.description:
TAD Pharma, based in Cuxhaven, Germany, with more than 250 employees, is one of the top 10 generic drug manufacturers in Germany in terms of sales. Its product range includes more than 100 active ingredients, mainly for the therapeutic areas of cardiovascular disease, pain, neurology, psychiatry, oncology, diabetes, OTC, and urology, as well as for veterinary medicine. In addition to its strong presence on the German market, TAD has also expanded its network abroad and exports its products to six foreign markets. 

TAD Pharma is a member of the Krka Group. Krka is one of the world's leading generic drug manufacturers and has many years of experience in the pharmaceutical industry. The focus is on prescription drugs, which are marketed under its own brand. The extensive portfolio of prescription drugs is complemented by OTC products for self-medication, personal care products, animal medicines, and health and tourism services. Krka serves customers in more than 70 countries.

Put your talent to good use and start your career at TAD Pharma as part of a collaborative team. We are looking for you to join us as soon as possible as a

Senior Accountant (m/f/d)

As Senior Accountant (m/f/d) you will play a key role in ensuring the financial integrity and compliance of our operations in Germany. Your responsibilities will include:

- Reporting and closing activities
Preparation of and responsibility for monthly, quarterly, and annual financial statements in accordance with IFRS, internal and external reporting, supporting the preparation of consolidation packages
- Accounting 
Overall responsibility for the proper execution of operational accounting for accounts receivable, accounts payable, fixed asset accounting, inventory accounting and general ledger accounting in compliance with applicable laws and guidelines and ensuring correct implementation
- Operational activities
Execution of closing entries, provisions, accruals, income entries and taxes, credit limit monitoring and control of payment transactions
- Co-operation with management
Interface function and active management of internal and external stakeholders, in particular close cooperation with headquarters, the director of the company, and local management
- Coaching and team development 
Coaching team colleagues on specific topics for the further development of accounting as well as exchange of best practices
- Financial audits
Collaboration with auditors, tax auditors, tax advisors, and authorities
- Process optimization projects
Management of optimization of processes, digitization, and further development of work-flows

Ideally you will have:

- A successfully completed university degree with major in accounting
- Several years of professional experience in a comparable position in an international corporation
- Confident knowledge of international accounting standards (IFRS)
- Routine experience with MS Office, especially Excel
- Experience with SAP R/3 (FI/CO/AA) and desired S4/Hana
- Good knowledge of English
- Analytical thinking and strong numerical skills
- Precise and conscientious approach to work
- Committed, solution-oriented and service-oriented approach to work
- Communication skills, flexibility and ability to work in a team
- Commitment and enthusiasm for new challenges in a successful German company within an international corporate environment

At TAD Pharma we offer:

- Exciting and cross-departmental development opportunities in a leading, established generic pharmaceutical company
- Our products are of EU-quality
- A strategic and innovative product portfolio
- Diverse jobs in a future-oriented growth industry
- A friendly, collegial, and team-oriented work environment
- An intensive training and onboarding program
- Various health benefits and company events
- A commitment to social and sustainability issues
- Equal opportunities

In summary we are looking for an enthusiastic and results-oriented personality who has initiative and flexibility and wants to prove their talent.

Seize this opportunity and start your career at a leading multinational generic pharmaceutical company.

If you are interested, please apply for the advertised position including your earliest possible starting date and salary expectations. We look forward to receiving your application!
